fields.field_label: Details of Modification of plan sanction / layout brief description
fields.raw_value: The Project Extent was increased from 09 Acres 33 Guntas to 23 Acres 31 Guntas. Initial Approval had 117 plots admeasuring to saleable area of 21,684.67 Square meter. As per the modified plan the total number of plots are 304 admeasuring to saleable area of 52,843.25 Square meters. We have received the RERA Certificate on the basis of 117 plots which was based on the old plan. At the time of Post Registration updation we were in receipt of modified plan of 304 plots. After Consulting with RERA Authority, they advised us to incorporate all the details of modification plan through Post Registration Portal and continue with Quarterly updates. The same were communicated with the RERA Authorities through request letter and hard copy attached with “OTHER DOCUMENTS (RELEVANT)” TAB in the Modification of Plan Form link. Later on a customer view of Ellegenza Phase – I through RERA Portal was showing the 117 Plots as per the old plan. Based on this we have requested to RERA Authorities to integrate the modified plan to the customer view option as well. We have lots of communication to RERA Authorities for the same modification. Due to this we were forced to stop the updation of quarterly progress.
